title: How to Write Funny Comic Strips
primaryKeyword: how to write funny comic strips
h1: How to Write Funny Comic Strips That Get Shared
description: Learn the secret structure of a joke, pacing panels, and writing punchlines for your comic strips.
intro: Humor is subjective, but the structure of a joke is universal. In a 3-panel or 4-panel comic strip, you have limited space to set up the premise, escalate the situation, and deliver the punchline. Here is our complete guide.
